responsibility: Implements emission of GCC optimization information as compressed JSON optimization-record files for -fsave-optimization-record. It builds the top-level document metadata and pass list, tracks nested scope arrays, converts dump implementation locations, source locations, profile counts, inlining chains, passes, and optinfo/optinfo_item payloads into JSON objects, and writes the accumulated result to dump_base_name.opt-record.json.gz via zlib.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the optinfo-emit-json group: it converts optinfo records, pass metadata, locations, counts, and nested scopes into JSON objects and writes the compressed .opt-record.json.gz file. Unlike optinfo-emit-json.h, which only declares optrecord_json_writer, this file contains the actual schema construction and output logic.
